verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent of the finished plate along the Y axis (plate width).
verification_targets.notes: Corresponds to PLATE_WIDTH_Y. Measured on the final solid from min y = 0 to max y = 50.

verification_targets.description: Overall bounding-box extent of the finished plate along the Z axis (plate thickness).

verification_targets.description: The finished plate with all four clearance holes MUST be a single connected solid body (no detached fragments).
The finished plate MUST be a closed, water-tight manifold mesh with no gaps, open edges, or self-intersections.
verification_targets.notes: Mesh must be manifold; all four through-holes must be fully closed cylindrical walls.

functional_requirements: Provide a flat, rigid rectangular mounting plate for fastening with M4 hardware
Four M4 clearance holes (4.2 mm nominal) for M4 bolts/screws — loose-fit clearance
Fastener clearance MUST allow standard M4 fasteners to pass freely through the 4.2 mm holes
Bottom face and top face MUST be flat and parallel to serve as a mounting/interface surface
Holes MUST be located with a consistent 10 mm edge inset to sit clear of the plate perimeter
Plate is intended to be load-bearing in through-thickness (Z) compression across the hole pattern
special_features: Plate MUST be a single solid rectangular prism of PLATE_LENGTH_X x PLATE_WIDTH_Y x PLATE_THICKNESS_Z with no pockets, ribs, bosses, or other added geometry

The four mounting holes MUST be placed one in each corner at the four coordinate combinations (HOLE_CENTER_X_MIN, HOLE_CENTER_Y_MIN), (HOLE_CENTER_X_MAX, HOLE_CENTER_Y_MIN), (HOLE_CENTER_X_MIN, HOLE_CENTER_Y_MAX), (HOLE_CENTER_X_MAX, HOLE_CENTER_Y_MAX) — not at arbitrary positions
Each mounting hole MUST be exactly HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_X from the nearest X-direction edge and exactly HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_Y from the nearest Y-direction edge (10 mm from both adjacent edges)

All four mounting holes MUST have diameter MOUNTING_HOLE_DIAMETER and MUST be through-holes penetrating the full PLATE_THICKNESS_Z along the Z axis (Rot(0) * Cylinder), not blind holes or holes along X/Y
The hole pattern MUST be symmetric about both the XZ centre plane at Y = PLATE_CENTER_Y and the YZ centre plane at X = PLATE_CENTER_X
No chamfers, fillets, countersinks, or edge breaks MUST be added — all edges and hole entries remain sharp as modelled
Plate length MUST be measured along the X axis, width along the Y axis, and thickness along the Z axis (plate lies flat in the XY plane)
cad_brief.user_request_raw:
Read the following plain-text part request and bind it to a formal claim, logic, and trusted base. Do not modify any repository files yet.

Part request: "Make a rectangular aluminum plate 100 mm long, 50 mm wide, and 5 mm thick, with four M4 clearance holes, one in each corner, each hole center 10 mm from the adjacent edges."

sketches.notes: Single solid rectangular plate profile, centered on the XY origin per the centroid_on_base_plane convention. Spans X = -50..+50 (PLATE_LENGTH_X = 100 along X) and Y = -25..+25 (PLATE_WIDTH_Y = 50 along Y). No pockets, ribs, bosses, or other added geometry. Symmetric about the YZ centre plane (X = 0) and the XZ centre plane (Y = 0).

steps.label: Extrude rectangular plate profile to 5 mm thickness (single prism)
steps.notes: Additive op FIRST. Uniform extrusion of the base-profile along +Z: plate occupies X = -50..+50, Y = -25..+25, Z = 0..+5. Length measured along X, width along Y, thickness along Z (plate lies flat in the XY plane). Result is exactly one rectangular prism with no added features. Volume before holes = 100 x 50 x 5 = 25000 mm^3.

steps.label: M4 clearance through-hole, corner 1 of 4 (X-min / Y-min)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z (Rot(0) * Cylinder), plate Z = 0..5, diameter 4.2 mm (M4 clearance). Position computed: HOLE_CENTER_X = 100/2 - 10 = 40.0 -> world x = -40.0; HOLE_CENTER_Y = 50/2 - 10 = 15.0 -> world y = -15.0. Exactly 10 mm from the X-min edge (x = -50) and exactly 10 mm from the Y-min edge (y = -25). Subtract AFTER the extrude.

steps.label: M4 clearance through-hole, corner 2 of 4 (X-max / Y-min)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z (Rot(0) * Cylinder), plate Z = 0..5, diameter 4.2 mm. Position: (+40.0, -15.0) = (PLATE_LENGTH_X/2 - HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_X, -PLATE_WIDTH_Y/2 + HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_Y) = (50 - 10, -25 + 10). Exactly 10 mm from the X-max edge (x = +50) and exactly 10 mm from the Y-min edge (y = -25). Hole pitch along X = 80.0 mm.

steps.label: M4 clearance through-hole, corner 3 of 4 (X-min / Y-max)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z (Rot(0) * Cylinder), plate Z = 0..5, diameter 4.2 mm. Position: (-40.0, +15.0) = (-PLATE_LENGTH_X/2 + HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_X, +PLATE_WIDTH_Y/2 - HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_Y) = (-50 + 10, 25 - 10). Exactly 10 mm from the X-min edge (x = -50) and exactly 10 mm from the Y-max edge (y = +25). Hole pitch along Y = 30.0 mm.

steps.label: M4 clearance through-hole, corner 4 of 4 (X-max / Y-max)
steps.notes: Through-hole along Z (Rot(0) * Cylinder), plate Z = 0..5, diameter 4.2 mm. Position: (+40.0, +15.0) = (+PLATE_LENGTH_X/2 - HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_X, +PLATE_WIDTH_Y/2 - HOLE_EDGE_OFFSET_Y) = (50 - 10, 25 - 10). Exactly 10 mm from the X-max edge (x = +50) and exactly 10 mm from the Y-max edge (y = +25). All four holes form a symmetric pattern about the YZ centre plane (X = 0) and the XZ centre plane (Y = 0). After all four cuts: remaining volume = 25000 - 4 * pi * 2.1^2 * 5 = 25000 - 277.1 = 24722.9 mm^3 (matches target_volume_mm3 = 24723).

revision_history: v1 - initial design: single extruded rectangular prism 100x50x5 mm with four 4.2 mm M4 clearance through-holes on a 80 x 30 mm pattern (10 mm edge offsets), symmetric about both centre planes, no fillets/chamfers.
